Warmth toward someone present. Distinct from longing by looking AT the person and smiling instead of gazing past them with parted lips, and from joy by half-closed rather than bright wide eyes.
face: gentle smile, faint blush, relaxed brow
eyes: half-closed eyes, looking at viewer, soft gaze
body: head tilt, leaning close, reaching toward face, open palm
